title: Dan Wilson links green fireballs to radiation drift
summary: Robert Hastings tells of Dan Wilson links green fireballs to radiation drift, about late 1940s at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Dan Wilson spent I don't know how many hours tracking down Green Fireball sightings that were coinciding with radiation drifting across the American landscape

plain: A researcher named Robert Hastings, who studies UFOs around nuclear bases, says on Jesse Michels's podcast that a man named Dan Wilson spent many hours tracking sightings of "green fireballs," glowing green lights seen in the sky in the late 1940s. According to Hastings, Wilson found the sightings lined up with radiation drifting across the American landscape, which would tie the lights to the nuclear age.
